title: Fire Blaster Enchant
description: Lets you shoot fireballs from your sword.
body:
This datapack adds a new enchantment to swords: The **Fire Blaster** enchantement. The enchantment has 2 levels. It takes skill to use this enchantment without accidentally blowing yourself up.
## What does the enchantment do?
This enchantment allows players to right click with their sword to summon a fireball! Leaving a firey crater wherever it hits. The power of the fireball increases with each level.
## That sounds too Overpowered!
Well, between each use, dependent on the level. The enchantment will be on cooldown, notifyinh you when it's off cooldown no matter the item you're holding.

Also, in order to use this enchantment, you must have at least 5 levels. Upon use, you then lose said levels. Making users second guess mending.
## Where can I find it?

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Fire Blaster is intended for late game use. Only being found rarely in Nether Fortress chests.
Alternatively, you can get Fire Blaster by enchanting a Netherite Sword in an Enchantment Table.

</details>

## Other notes:
This datapack also adds Sword Blocking back for diamond and netherite swords. As of version 1, there is no disadvantages to this apart from being unable to attack.

To use this enchantment in creative, you must craft the sword instead of grabbing it from the creative inventory.
